claim_policy.note: A claim helps creators avoid accidental duplication. It grants no review role, acceptance, publication, or default-registry position.

commissions.title: Recover an offline field log
commissions.brief: Show a local-first field log surviving a cold reload without network access, exporting a verifiable record, and rejecting a damaged import without losing the good copy.

objective_evidence.criterion: After the supplied twelve-observation fixture is loaded and the network is disabled, a cold reload still shows 12 observations and the exported file reports the fixture's expected SHA-256.
objective_evidence.acceptance: The film names the expected count and digest; the live replay exposes both values in the running app.

positive_path.demonstration: Create one observation, reload offline, find it again, and export the complete log.

visible_failure.demonstration: Attempt to import a deliberately truncated fixture and show a visible rejection while the twelve good observations remain.

steps: Reload the page with the network disabled.
exact_reset.restored_state: The supplied twelve-observation fixture is present, no extra draft remains, and the export digest returns to the documented fixture value.

rights_privacy.scope: Use synthetic field notes and creator-owned interface assets only.

commissions.title: Triage invoices without a pointer
commissions.brief: Demonstrate a small invoice queue that can be reviewed, corrected, and exported using only a keyboard and a visible focus path.

objective_evidence.criterion: The three-invoice fixture totals 196.25, every control is reachable by keyboard, and the exported accepted-total field is exactly 196.25.
objective_evidence.acceptance: The film states the expected total; the live replay shows keyboard focus, the computed total, and the exported value.

positive_path.demonstration: Using Tab, arrow keys, and Enter only, accept two invoices, correct the third, and export the queue.

visible_failure.demonstration: Enter a negative amount and show an inline error, disabled export, and focus moved to the invalid field.

steps: Move focus to the first invoice row.
exact_reset.restored_state: All three invoices are pending, the displayed total is 196.25, no validation error is visible, and focus is on the first row.

rights_privacy.scope: All people, vendors, account numbers, and invoice values must be synthetic.

commissions.title: Teach one orbital transfer by prediction
commissions.brief: Teach a Hohmann-style transfer by asking the learner for a prediction before revealing the simulation and numerical result.

objective_evidence.criterion: For the embedded training fixture, the computed total delta-v must equal the fixture's documented 3.58 km/s within 0.01 km/s and the trajectory must intersect the target-orbit tolerance band.
objective_evidence.acceptance: The formula inputs, computed value, tolerance, and final intersection are readable in both modes.

positive_path.demonstration: Record a learner prediction, run the two burns, and compare the predicted and measured delta-v.

visible_failure.demonstration: Apply the provided under-burn preset and show the craft miss the target band with the numerical shortfall visible.

exact_reset.restored_state: The original radii and mass are restored, no prediction is recorded, both burns are unapplied, and time reads 0.00.

rights_privacy.scope: Use original diagrams, public-domain references, or clearly attributed compatible sources.

commissions.title: Explain why a grid overflows
commissions.brief: Turn one common CSS Grid overflow bug into an inspectable lesson with a before state, a measured diagnosis, and a fix the viewer can undo.

objective_evidence.criterion: The failing fixture has scrollWidth greater than clientWidth at 320 px; after the fix those values are equal at both 320 px and 1280 px.
objective_evidence.acceptance: The exact viewport, scrollWidth, and clientWidth values are displayed before and after the change.

positive_path.demonstration: Inspect the overflowing track, apply the minmax or min-width fix, and verify both target viewport widths.

visible_failure.demonstration: Restore the unbreakable-token fixture and visibly reproduce horizontal scrolling at 320 px.

steps: Set the viewport control to 320 px.
Scroll the preview back to x = 0.
exact_reset.restored_state: The original CSS text, long token, 320 px viewport, and measured overflow are identical to the opening state.

rights_privacy.scope: The lesson source, fixture text, fonts, and screenshots must be redistributable.

commissions.title: Prove a deterministic Hive merge
commissions.brief: Build a small visual proof of RAPP Hive traversal, revision selection, and channel shadowing using fixed local fixtures and no network dependency.

objective_evidence.criterion: For the supplied cyclic three-Hive fixture, traversal terminates after three unique Hives, revision sequence 9 wins for the duplicate Hive id, and the root-priority channel entry wins the shadow conflict.
objective_evidence.acceptance: The visited order, selected revision, winning channel source, and shadowed source are emitted as inspectable data.

positive_path.demonstration: Run the fixed merge twice with the same root priority and show byte-identical result digests.

visible_failure.demonstration: Load a fixture with a negative revision sequence and show it become unavailable rather than an empty successful Hive.

steps: Restore root priority to alpha then beta.
Clear the traversal log and run counter.
exact_reset.restored_state: The three original Hive objects, root priority, empty visited set, and documented expected digest are restored.

rights_privacy.scope: Fixtures must contain invented Hive names and local relative URLs only.

commissions.title: Prove a white-furnace energy bound
commissions.brief: Make a compact renderer proof in which the viewer can run a white-furnace test, introduce a biased estimator, and restore the known-good integrator.

objective_evidence.criterion: With albedo 1.0, seed 42, and 256 samples per pixel, mean luminance error must be at most 1.00 percent.
objective_evidence.acceptance: The input seed, sample count, measured mean, error percentage, and threshold are visible and exportable.

positive_path.demonstration: Run the reference integrator from zero samples to 256 samples per pixel and show the error settle inside the bound.

visible_failure.demonstration: Enable the supplied biased-weight toggle and show error exceed 5 percent with an unmistakable failing state.

exact_reset.restored_state: The reference integrator is selected, the sample counter is zero, the image is cleared, and all fixture inputs match the opening state.

rights_privacy.scope: Shader, scene, textures, and explanatory graphics must be original or compatibly licensed.

commissions.title: Make one button carry a rhythm game
commissions.brief: Create a readable one-button rhythm challenge whose deterministic chart can demonstrate a clean run, a real miss, and an exact retry.

objective_evidence.criterion: The fixture chart contains exactly 16 cues; the reference input trace scores 16 hits within the 50 ms perfect window and produces the documented score.
objective_evidence.acceptance: Cue count, hit offsets, judgement windows, combo, and final score are visible or exportable.

positive_path.demonstration: Play the deterministic reference trace through all 16 cues and reach the documented perfect result.

visible_failure.demonstration: Skip the fourth cue and show the miss judgement, broken combo, changed audio or visual response, and lower score.

steps: Leave the input untouched at beat zero.
exact_reset.restored_state: The same 16-cue chart is at time zero with score 0, combo 0, no judgements, and the original deterministic seed.

rights_privacy.scope: Music, samples, chart, type, and visual assets must be creator-owned or clearly redistributable.

commissions.title: Escape and replay a seeded maze
commissions.brief: Build a small maze whose seed, shortest route, failure room, and reset are legible enough for a viewer to verify and then take over.

objective_evidence.criterion: Seed RAPP-42 always generates the same topology digest and an 18-step shortest route from the marked entrance to the exit.
objective_evidence.acceptance: The seed, topology digest, current step count, and reference shortest-path length are visible.

positive_path.demonstration: Follow the 18-step reference route, open the exit, and display the matched optimal length.

visible_failure.demonstration: Take the marked wrong turn into the trap room and show the route become longer than the reference without hiding the exit.

exact_reset.restored_state: The original topology digest, entrance position, north-facing camera, zero step count, closed exit, and empty trail are restored.

rights_privacy.scope: All game code, sounds, textures, and level-generation assets must be original or compatible.

commissions.title: Create a six-icon vector system
commissions.brief: Show a tiny vector tool producing six related icons from shared geometric rules, then deliberately break and restore one rule.

objective_evidence.criterion: The export contains exactly six named 24 by 24 SVG symbols and the reference raster comparison remains below 0.50 percent differing pixels.
objective_evidence.acceptance: Symbol count, viewBox, names, raster comparison method, measured difference, and exported SVG are inspectable.

positive_path.demonstration: Edit the shared stroke rule, regenerate all six symbols, and export the passing SVG sprite.

visible_failure.demonstration: Move one anchor off the shared grid and show the raster comparison fail with the changed pixels highlighted.

steps: Select the first symbol and clear comparison overlays.
exact_reset.restored_state: All six original paths, shared rules, names, selection, zoom, and passing reference comparison are restored.

rights_privacy.scope: Icons, fonts, reference rasters, and tool code must be original or compatibly licensed.

commissions.title: Create an eight-bar drum loop
commissions.brief: Compose a deterministic eight-bar rhythm, expose the event data behind it, show one timing defect, and export a verifiable audio render.

objective_evidence.criterion: At 120 BPM in 4/4, the loop contains exactly 32 note events and the exported WAV duration is 16.000 seconds within 0.010 seconds.
objective_evidence.acceptance: Tempo, bar count, event count, event timestamps, render duration, and export digest are visible or exportable.

positive_path.demonstration: Build the final pattern, play all eight bars, and export the 32-event passing render.

visible_failure.demonstration: Move the supplied kick event off-grid and show the timing audit identify its exact bar, beat, and offset.

steps: Return the playhead to bar 1 beat 1.
Clear the timing audit and export history.
exact_reset.restored_state: Tempo is 120 BPM, all 32 original events and velocities are restored, the playhead is at zero, and no stale render remains.

rights_privacy.scope: All samples, synthesis, pattern data, cover art, and recorded audio must be creator-owned or redistributable.

commissions.title: Explore an ecosystem threshold
commissions.brief: Let the viewer sweep one model parameter, observe a stable band and a collapse, and reset to a reproducible starting population.

objective_evidence.criterion: With seed 31415 and grazing rate 0.24, the fixture population remains between 80 and 120 at tick 600; with grazing rate 0.60 it falls below 10 before tick 300.
objective_evidence.acceptance: Seed, parameter values, tick number, population series, thresholds, and final measurements are visible and exportable.

positive_path.demonstration: Run the 0.24 fixture through tick 600 and inspect the population staying inside the documented band.

visible_failure.demonstration: Increase grazing to 0.60 and show the population cross the collapse threshold with the crossing tick marked.

exact_reset.restored_state: Tick is zero, the original population and resources are restored, the chart is empty, and all fixture parameters match the opening state.

rights_privacy.scope: Use synthetic model data and original or compatible species illustrations and sounds.

commissions.title: Explore change across two archive maps
commissions.brief: Build a spatial comparison over a synthetic 24-record archive where the viewer can isolate changed records, trigger an empty query, and return to the same view.

objective_evidence.criterion: Comparing the fixture's 1990 and 2020 snapshots yields exactly seven changed record ids, and the exported sorted id list matches the embedded expected list.
objective_evidence.acceptance: Snapshot labels, total record count, changed count, sorted ids, spatial extent, and export digest are inspectable.

positive_path.demonstration: Compare the two snapshots, filter to the seven changed records, inspect one record, and export the sorted id list.

visible_failure.demonstration: Select the supplied impossible date range and show a clear empty state that is not rendered as a successful zero-change comparison.

steps: Reset filters, selection, pan, and zoom.
exact_reset.restored_state: All 24 records are visible at the original extent, the seven-change comparison is selected, no record is focused, and the expected export digest is restored.

rights_privacy.scope: Records, coordinates, names, images, and dates must be synthetic or cleared for public redistribution.
